invariants.rationale: The method calls parseRegionName(name); if 'name' were null, it would probably throw, indicating method expects non-null 'name'.
The method returns atlas.findRegion(parseRegionName(name)), so result must be equal to that expression for any input.
parseRegionName(name) produces the string used to look up the region; it is likely non-null as most region lookup would require a non-null key.
